svg.title: What Spark's generated code calls
svg.desc: Spark's generated code calls java.lang.StrictMath for exp, expm1, ln, log10, log1p and power, and for log2, log with a base and atanh through StrictMath.log and log1p. The base class's default, java.lang.Math, serves sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, sinh, cosh, tanh, cbrt and sqrt.
